params.caption: 🎮 Rockstar details GTA 6 on consoles: 30 FPS everywhere, no 60 FPS on PS5 Pro Rockstar has laid out how GTA 6 runs at launch: it targets 30 FPS on every PlayStation and Xbox console. PS5 and Xbox Series X run at 1440p with Rockstar's own temporal anti-aliasing, PS5 Pro uses Sony's PSSR 2, and Xbox Series S drops to 720p upscaled with AMD's FSR 4. Rockstar also says the PS5 Pro can't handle a 60 FPS mode, so don't expect a performance patch soon. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 18:22 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: PC Gamer · VGC · Tom's Hardware 👥 @RockstarGames · @PlayStation · @Xbox 🎯 Is 30 FPS a dealbreaker?
